timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹200.55 Cr (+5.5% YoY), net profit ₹19.72 Cr (+4.6% YoY).
Pudumjee Paper Products reported FY26 revenue of ₹807.88 Cr and completed a ₹110 Cr capex program including a 15.4 MW solar plant.
Pudumjee Paper Products received a credit rating review from CRISIL, reaffirming its ratings and revising the outlook to Stable from Positive.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹227.3 Cr (+9.7% YoY), net profit ₹22.72 Cr (+34.3% YoY).
Pudumjee Paper reported H1 FY27 turnover of ₹430 Cr with EBITDA at 21% or ₹90 Cr, aided by capex benefits.
